provenance.modifications: third_party/patches/daisysp-esp32-daw.patch: per-object generator replaces libc rand(); resonator Q mapping fixed (Plaits Q -> Svf res) in AnalogSnareDrum / AnalogBassDrum; AnalogBassDrum decay range restored to Plaits 0..1; Plaits one-pole restored for the snare pulse low-pass; single-precision sin / cos / literals on the audio path (AnalogBassDrum, AnalogSnareDrum, HiHat); AnalogBassDrum / SyntheticBassDrum cache parameter and sample-rate coefficients; Svf sets frequency / Plaits Q together, avoiding redundant damping, general exponentiation and an inactive stability limit; HiHat caches decay / tone / noise coefficients and filter settings; SquareNoise caches oscillator increments until pitch changes; AnalogSnareDrum / SyntheticSnareDrum cache coefficients, filter settings, mode gains and static modulation factors
